name: pairs
meaning: OBJECTnnPAST / OBJECTnnPRESENT (prop offsets from table 0x57b780); used only when both are non-NULL

name: state
meaning: TimeMachineSphereState 0..8

name: seedCount
meaning: number of Seed (class 93) objects found, max 5

name: chrono
meaning: TimeMachineChrono (class 85) from FindByClass; written by Init, not read by the sphere code

name: seeds
meaning: Seed objects asked with msg 0x3281 for a return-arrival position

name: followerWaitMs
meaning: state-7 follower wait: 3000, decremented by g_dtMs; at <= 0 the followers get msg 0x75

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: 1 if the Wolf accepted msg 0xE in state 1/7; msg 0xF sent at the swap; cleared by msg 0xE to the sphere

name: wolfInsideSinceArrival
meaning: Set to 1 by the present->past swap. State 3 then opens the return path (5/6) instead of closing (4/0). In state 6 it stays 1 only while the Wolf remains in the ±0xB9 cube, so Ralph must step out and back in.

name: dragonFollows
meaning: Dragon reply to msg 0x38 (nonzero = will come along)

name: dragon
meaning: Dragon (class 84)

name: gossamerFollows
meaning: Gossamer_Lev08 reply to msg 0x38

name: gossamer
meaning: Gossamer_Lev08 (class 87)

name: bull
meaning: bull (class 43); gets msg 0x38 (return home) when travel starts

name: billboard
meaning: embedded ScnBody (ctor sets the ScnObject/ScnBody vtables at +0x228) built from export 0x7D WAR_IDO_ABTIME02, rendered camera-facing; inst +0x22c, pos +0x234, anim +0x268, animId +0x282

name: billboardRecord
meaning: synthetic WAR record written by Scn_BuildRecordFromExport for the billboard

name: humSound
meaning: Sound 0xCD looping in state 6; stopped when state 7 starts and in Reset

name: openSound
meaning: Sound 0x13E started in state 2; stopped at the end of state 4/5 and in Reset

name: wolfArrivalQuery
meaning: msg 0x3281 arg for the Wolf {g_pWolf; pos filled by a Seed}

name: gossamerArrivalQuery
meaning: msg 0x3281 arg for the Gossamer {gossamer; its pos, overwritten by a Seed} (the sphere writes only .obj; a Seed writes .pos)

name: releaseCamNextFrame
meaning: set after an era swap; the next Update calls Camera_ReleaseScripted (a one-frame camera cut)

name: useDefaultArrival
meaning: scratch: 1 until a Seed answers msg 0x3281 for the Gossamer
